archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with 3 (Pastel & Soft) - Vibrant Utility

css_variable_migration.strategy: Replace explicit dark/gold variables with semantic light/vibrant tokens in /app/frontend/src/index.css.

typography.headings: Outfit or General Sans, sans-serif (Bold, energetic, tracking-tight for H1/H2)
typography.body: Manrope or Figtree, sans-serif (Clean, highly legible for dense menus/data)

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-primary text-white font-bold hover:bg-[#E04D00] transition-all shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgba(255,90,0,0.39)] hover:shadow-lg active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-secondary text-white font-semibold hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all
buttons.outline: rounded-full border-2 border-slate-200 text-[var(--secondary)] font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors

cards.container: bg-surface rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]

bottom_nav_mobile.container: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-100 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center z-50
bottom_nav_mobile.item_active: text-primary flex flex-col items-center gap-1 font-bold
bottom_nav_mobile.item_inactive: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 font-medium

badges.promo: bg-[#FFF0E5] text-primary px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide
badges.status_active: bg-[#E6F8F1] text-success px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 for restaurant/category listings.
spacing_and_layout.paddings: Use generous padding (p-4 to p-6) inside cards. App layout should have a max-width wrapper (max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8) for desktop.
spacing_and_layout.hero_section: Generous py-16 md:py-24, overlay should be minimal gradient. Focus on clean layout, left-aligned text, right-aligned dynamic image.

texture_and_feel.caribbean_identity: Subtle touch. Use a very faint grain/noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to mimic sand/warmth. Do NOT overdo palm leaves. Keep it professional and functional like DoorDash. Use Turquoise (#0EA5E9) for small accents like active map routes or notification dots.
texture_and_feel.shadows: Soft, ambient, airy shadows. Avoid harsh black dropshadows.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements (buttons, nav items, tabs, map markers, cart items) MUST include a unique data-testid attribute for automated testing. Example: data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='nav-home'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure primary Orange (#FF5A00) has sufficient contrast against white. Use Navy (#0F172A) for all critical text to maintain WCAG AA compliance.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Open /app/frontend/src/index.css and replace the dark/gold variables with the new semantic tokens provided in css_variable_migration.
2. Update tailwind.config.js to map colors to these new CSS variables (e.g., colors: { primary: 'rgb(var(--primary) / <alpha-value>)' }).
3. Review the main Layout, Navigation, and App components to switch classes from dark (bg-matte-900, text-white) to light (bg-background, text-primary).
4. Update the Button and Card primitives according to component_styling (pill shapes, soft shadows, borders).
5. Ensure the Mobile bottom tab bar has a solid/blurred background and high contrast active states.
6. Add data-testid to all interactive components as you touch them.
7. Ensure the app remains functionally complete during styling; do not remove any existing logic or routes.
